data.comment:
# Comfy Kling O1- Video to Video

Transform videos with Kling O1. Edit video content, change styles, or replace characters using text prompts and reference images. Runs on Comfy Cloud and needs Comfy Cloud partner credits.

**How it works:** The Comfy nodes form the complete template graph. Run submits the graph to Comfy Cloud and saves its outputs.

**Try this:** Change the prompt or the Load node inputs and run again to compare results.

Source: https://github.com/Comfy-Org/workflow_templates/blob/1ae390968e323dba24a6991d1860ded051f5a79b/templates/api_kling_omni_v2v.json (MIT). Model licenses apply separately.

data.prompt: Transform the dancing person into the anthropomorphic rabbit character from the reference image. The rabbit character, dressed in a light blue knitted cardigan over a white shirt and light brown pants, should replicate all the dancing movements and poses from the original video. Keep the same background, camera movement, and dance sequence, but replace the human character with the rabbit character while maintaining the same energetic and dynamic dancing style.
